h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kishanganj

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kishanganj

items.pText: Kishanganj sits in the far north-east of Bihar, close to the West Bengal border and the tea country of north Bengal. It is one of the wettest parts of the state, and the long monsoon decides what kind of playground equipment will last here. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor play equipment in Vasai, Maharashtra, and we send it about 1,710 km by road to schools, societies and public gardens in Kishanganj.

Most buyers in a town this size are schools and small housing societies setting up their first proper play area. We help you choose a few pieces that suit the age group and the ground, then send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. After you approve the layout and the quote, we manufacture, dispatch and install, either with our own team or through a dealer in eastern India.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Materials that survive a long, wet monsoon

c: Months of rain and high humidity rust bare iron quickly, and painted mild steel starts flaking within a few seasons. Our frames are galvanised pipe, where a zinc coating protects the steel, and slides, panels and seats are roto-moulded plastic that cannot rust at all. Both carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
Ground matters as much as material. Pick the highest, best-drained part of your campus, and lay
under swings and slide exits so children are not landing in mud. Our
are a sensible first purchase for a school starting small.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,710 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can FunPlay send equipment as far as Kishanganj?
items.a: Yes. Everything is made at our Vasai factory and transported by road. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in eastern India, using grouting or a self-standing base.

items.q: How do we stop the play area turning muddy in the rains?
items.a: Raise the base slightly, give it a gentle slope for drainage and lay rubber flooring under the equipment. Rubber dries quickly after a shower and cushions falls better than wet soil.

items.q: What should a school in Kishanganj buy first?
items.a: A swing set, a see-saw and a slide cover the basic play needs of most primary classes. You can add a multi play system later, and we will plan space for it on the first layout.
